guide.heroSubtitle: Follow these simple steps to document your thank you message to the guardians of the UAE
guide.step1Desc: Open your browser and navigate to the Shukran Watan platform. Click "Send Message" from the navigation bar or the home page to begin.
guide.step2Desc: Fill in your full name and phone number. Your name will appear on your participation certificate. Select your nationality and the emirate you are based in.
guide.step3Desc: Select your category: Citizen or Resident. This helps us categorize participation across the nation.
guide.step4Desc: Compose a heartfelt message of gratitude between 10 and 500 characters. Your words will be documented in the national record.
guide.step5Desc: Tap the microphone icon to record a voice message up to 60 seconds. You can preview, delete, and re-record before submitting. This step is optional.
guide.step6Desc: Click the "Document Message" button to send your message. Wait a moment while your message is being processed and documented.
guide.step7Desc: After successful submission, you will receive a unique document number. Download your Certificate of Participation as a keepsake image.
guide.ctaDesc: Your message makes a difference. Be part of history and contribute to a Guinness World Record.

sheikhaShama.heroSubtitle: A message from H.H. Dr. Shamma bint Mohammed bin Khalid Al Nahyan for the Thank You, Guardians of the Nation platform
sheikhaShama.name: H.H. Dr. Shamma bint Mohammed bin Khalid Al Nahyan
sheikhaShama.role: Chairperson of Sheikh Mohammed bin Khalid Al Nahyan Cultural and Educational Institutions
sheikhaShama.p1: To the men of the UAE Armed Forces…
sheikhaShama.p2: To those who made honor a creed, belonging a mission, and protecting the homeland a meaning that transcends the bounds of duty to the rank of pure loyalty.
sheikhaShama.p3: Thank you… for granting the nation the feeling of safety.
sheikhaShama.p4: Thank you for making sacrifice a language that needs no interpretation.
sheikhaShama.p5: Thank you for writing every day, with your actions not your words, what it means for the UAE to be strong, safe, and proud.
sheikhaShama.p6: May God protect our Armed Forces and the United Arab Emirates, and may its glory endure under the leadership of His Highness Sheikh Mohammed bin Zayed Al Nahyan, President of the State, may God protect him, who placed humanity and the nation at the heart of every vision and journey.
sheikhaShama.signature: Dr. Shamma Mohammed Khalid Al Nahyan
